title.en: Routines are linked to the conversations that started them
title.zh: 定时任务与发起它的对话相关联

description.en: Routines are grouped by conversation, can be created and changed from within it, and show their recent runs.
description.zh: 定时任务按对话分组，可在对话中创建与修改，并可查看最近的运行记录。

title.en: Edit an agent's folder, API key and endpoint from its profile
title.zh: 可在智能体资料页直接修改工作目录、API 密钥与接口地址

description.en: Manage Agents now shows the model each agent actually uses, and changes made there take effect.
description.zh: 「管理智能体」显示的即为智能体实际使用的模型，在此修改后同步生效。

title.en: Unread counts are no longer repeated in the conversation list
title.zh: 会话列表不再重复显示未读数

description.en: Project groups mark unread conversations with a red dot.
description.zh: 项目分组改用红点提示未读。
